rulesTestNames: lets a guest get and list only their own contact permissions
owner: messaging contact permission writer, called in the same transaction by every consent writer
read: server only; no client and no organiser reads receipts
write: server only and append-only: created beside the catchCommunicationPermissionReceipts or organizerCommunicationPermissionReceipts receipt it copies, with the same id
migrationNotes: Issue #2460 phase 1. Holds the union of the two receipt collections' fields plus senderKind and senderId. Account deletion deletes a person's receipts exactly as it deletes the old receipt collections; whether to keep them anonymised instead awaits counsel (OQ-C2).
